meta.title: Correlation framework — how correlation values are determined and controlled
meta.note: Pearson r is computed with the NIST-published formula and tested for significance with the NIST F(1, N−2) test. IMPORTANT: no official source publishes numeric correlation coefficients for specific bet-leg pairs (sportsbooks keep their correlation models private), so all numeric r values in this project are left blank until computed from our own logged data; those cells are flagged in data/flagged.json rather than invented.

rows.method: Pearson correlation coefficient r = Sxy / sqrt(Sxx·Syy), range −1 to +1; significance tested via F(1, N−2): VAL = |(N−2)r²/(1−r²)|, p-value = 1 − CDF
rows.value_status: unverified — computed from our own bet logs at runtime; no official source publishes these values

rows.method: For multi-game parlays and prop combos, compute pairwise r between leg signals over the backtest window; reject any leg pair with |r| above the gate threshold (threshold itself set during validation and recorded per strategy) or any pair the sportsbook restricts as a related contingency / ‘too closely related’; books explicitly reserve the right to restrict correlated parlays
rows.value_status: unverified — threshold set from our own data; book restriction rule is verified

rows.method: SGP legs are inherently correlated; books price SGPs with correlation models rather than multiplying leg odds; our policy: build an SGP only with an explicit joint-probability estimate from our own model, never the naive product of leg probabilities
rows.value_status: unverified — sportsbook SGP correlation matrices are proprietary, not published by any official source

rows.concept: Joint probability under independence vs correlation
rows.method: If legs were independent, P(A and B) = P(A)·P(B); with Pearson r ≠ 0 the product is wrong — positively correlated legs are more likely together (lower combined probability than independence implies), negatively correlated legs less so; always use measured joint frequency from logged data, not the product
rows.value_status: unverified — directional relationship verified via NIST definition; numeric values computed from our own data

rows.method: Track correlation of bet outcomes across the slate (same division games, same weather region, same game script); cap total exposure to any correlated cluster so one script outcome cannot sink the bankroll (gate G7)
rows.value_status: unverified — computed from our own bet logs

rows.method: When scanning many candidate signals for predictive power, require the correlation test p-value to survive Bonferroni correction across the number of tests (α/g) to avoid promoting noise
rows.value_status: method verified; numeric values computed from our own data
